requirements.text: An account owner can create, edit, and delete an overlay with content and active state.
A link selects at most one overlay owned by its account.
An eligible link visit renders the overlay before final delivery.
Continue revalidates link availability/access, records completion, and redirects.
Attached safe provider pixels run on the interstitial only after visitor consent.
A LinkPilot-controlled interstitial can use optional start, expiry, and display-delay controls; remote-page injection is excluded.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Continue re-runs link controls before recording completion or redirecting.
Overlay content is always LinkPilot-controlled and cannot inject into a destination page.

observedBehaviors: CTA overlays are shown as rows with status and row actions.
A create action appears in the resource toolbar.

implementationEvidence.description: OverlayDeliveryTest and OverlaySchedulingTest passed; the full isolated Laravel suite passed 428 tests and 15,151 assertions with only the ClamAV-dependent PDF-delivery case skipped.

Owner browser verified a scheduled five-second overlay deadline and continue flow at desktop and 390px. At 390x844, create/edit dialogs stayed within the viewport with internal scrolling; keyboard traversal revealed the edit Save action inside the dialog, and the manager had no horizontal overflow.

Current Task 3 overlay suites passed inside the focused run, including management, ownership, consented views, access-code gates, continuation revalidation, scheduling, and server-side delay enforcement.
implementationEvidence.reference: tests/Feature/Overlays; Task 3 focused run (363 passed, 1 skipped, 4166 assertions)

implementationEvidence.description: Managed Chromium captured the populated overlay manager at desktop and its responsive mobile surface with no HTTP/page errors or horizontal overflow.
